fields.name: override_groups
docs: Safety overrides below the weather threshold (C17); counted as payer-missing groups.

fields.name: flags
docs: bit 0 covariate imbalance, 1 meter check, 2 too few groups, 3 data quality; bits 4-7 zero.

fields.name: envelope_hash
docs: sha256 of the verifier envelope; must equal `Deal.envelope_hash`.

fields.name: vaults
docs: Token accounts created by `init_vaults` (index = `V_*`); later commands accept only these addresses.

fields.name: tranche_mints
docs: P1: Token-2022 tranche mints set by `register_tranche_mints` (default key = P0 deal without tokens).

fields.name: votes
docs: sha256(borsh(payload)) voted by each verifier; zero = not voted.

fields.name: outcome
docs: logic::settle::OUT_* (0 normal, 1 payer violation, 2 investor over-cap, 3 no bound).

fields.name: pending
docs: P1: distributions settled by a transfer and not yet claimed.
